title: Add bcrypt and subtle crates to reader Cargo.toml
description:
What: Add bcrypt and subtle crates for password hashing and constant-time comparison.
Algorithm:
1. Add to crates/reader/Cargo.toml [dependencies]:
   bcrypt = "0.15"
   subtle = "2"
2. Verify cargo build -p usenet-ipfs-reader compiles
3. Verify cargo test clean
Defensive: do not enable std feature on subtle unnecessarily.
Acceptance: cargo build + cargo test clean.
